remarks: Nestled on a picturesque, tree-lined street with sidewalks in one of North Tonawanda’s most desirable neighborhoods, this 2 bedroom brick ranch/bungalow offers an exceptional blend of comfort, major structural updates, and outstanding potential. From the moment you step inside, you are greeted by a cozy living area highlighted by a classic wood-burning fireplace, tastefully framed by a handsome mantle with built-in shelving. Nearby, the kitchen comes fully equipped with a complete set of stainless steel appliances. Major mechanical and exterior improvements have already been taken care of for you, including an updated furnace and central AC unit, low-maintenance vinyl windows, and a 3 year old complete tear off architectural roof. The home also features a full basement with an updated 150-amp electrical service and durable glass block windows, providing secure natural light and ample storage or workshop space. Out back, the property boasts a remarkably large backyard, perfect for outdoor dining, gardening, or entertaining family and friends, all while remaining just minutes from local parks, shopping, dining, and everyday amenities. While the key systems are rock solid, bringing a little bit of TLC and your personal design ideas will quickly transform this functional diamond in the rough into a complete gem. Whether you are a first-time homebuyer looking to build equity, an empty nester seeking single story ease, or someone searching for the ideal place to downsize without compromising on lot size or location, this charming home is a rare opportunity you won't want to miss.
